title: Improve electrician website: clear services, navigation, CTAs, SEO, reviews, and performance

requirements.text: Update the primary navigation to include only these menu items: Home | Services | About Us | Contact. Ensure both desktop and mobile navigation reflect this and that clicking each item smoothly scrolls to the correct section.

quotes: Menu me: Home | Services | About Us | Contact ye chaar sections zaroor ho.

acceptanceCriteria: Header desktop navigation shows exactly 4 items: Home, Services, About Us, Contact.
Header mobile menu shows the same 4 items and closes after selection.
Footer "Quick Links" shows the same 4 items.
Each nav item scrolls to a visible section heading (not hidden under the fixed header).

requirements.text: Make the Services offering easy to understand by presenting these services as clearly separated service entries (either as sub-sections within the Services section and/or as dedicated detail views): Home Wiring, Emergency Repairs, Fuse/Panel Upgrades, Light Fitting/LED Work, Appliance Installation. Each service entry must have a title, a short description, an icon, and a professional image.

quotes: Har service ko separate section ya page de do, for example: ✔ Home wiring ✔ Emergency repairs ✔ Fuse/Panel upgrades ✔ Light fitting/LED work ✔ Appliance installation

acceptanceCriteria: The Services area prominently includes the 5 listed services as distinct items (not buried among many unrelated categories).
Each of the 5 services displays: title, description, icon, and image.
Each service item includes a visible call-to-action (CTA) that leads the visitor to contact/booking (e.g., scroll to Contact or open a call link).
All service images include descriptive alt text in English.

requirements.text: Add prominent CTAs across the site so users can take action from every major section (Home/Hero, Services, About Us, Contact): “Get a Free Quote”, “Book Now”, and “Call Us”. The “Call Us” CTA must use the existing phone number and a tel: link.

quotes: Har page pe visible CTA add karo: “Get a Free Quote”, “Book Now”, “Call Us”

acceptanceCriteria: Hero section contains clearly visible CTAs including “Get a Free Quote”, “Book Now”, and “Call Us”.
Services section provides at least one visible CTA per service (or per service card) that enables booking/quote/call.
“Call Us” opens the dialer using a tel: link and uses the existing number (9953854470).
CTAs are usable on mobile without overlapping the fixed header.

requirements.text: Implement a floating, always-available contact CTA component that improves conversions on mobile and desktop (e.g., a compact floating bar or buttons) with at least: Call and WhatsApp actions. Ensure it does not block key content or form fields.

quotes: Har page pe visible CTA add karo

acceptanceCriteria: A floating CTA is visible on scroll (especially on mobile).
Floating CTA includes a Call action (tel:9953854470) and a WhatsApp action (using the existing WhatsApp URL helper).
Floating CTA does not cover the Contact form submit button or inputs on common screen sizes.

requirements.text: Add a customer reviews / social proof section that displays multiple testimonials with names and star ratings. Place it in a sensible location in the single-page flow (e.g., after Services and before Contact) and ensure it is visually consistent with the rest of the site.

quotes: Customer Reviews / Social Proof Testimonials add karo — real feedback visitors par trust banata hai. Star ratings ya Google reviews bhi dikhane se credibility badhti hai.

acceptanceCriteria: A new section for testimonials is visible on the page with a clear heading (in English).
At least 3 testimonials are shown with star ratings and short review text.
The section is responsive and readable on mobile.
No third-party review API integration is required (static testimonials are acceptable).

requirements.text: Implement basic on-page SEO improvements: set a keyword-focused page title and meta description (English), and ensure key images have meaningful alt text. Use the provided example format for the title as guidance.

quotes: Page titles & meta descriptions me keywords use karo. Example: “Electrician in Mumbai – Emergency Electrician Services” Images ke alt tags aur service pages ka SEO optimize karo.

acceptanceCriteria: The HTML page title is updated to a clean, keyword-focused English title (no extra/duplicate words).
A meta description tag is present and includes relevant electrician service keywords in English.
All service images and major hero imagery have non-empty, descriptive English alt attributes.
No broken meta tags are introduced (valid HTML head).

requirements.text: Improve performance for fast loading by optimizing image loading behavior and preventing unnecessarily heavy above-the-fold assets. Use sensible defaults such as lazy-loading below-the-fold images and ensuring images are appropriately sized for their display containers.

quotes: Site fast load ho (images optimize karo).

acceptanceCriteria: Below-the-fold images (e.g., Services/Products cards) use lazy-loading behavior.
No layout-breaking changes are introduced while images load.
The site remains responsive and smooth on mobile devices.

requirements.text: Ensure the site is served securely without mixed content: all external links opened from CTAs (e.g., WhatsApp) must use https URLs, and there must be no http resource references in the frontend.
acceptanceCriteria: No frontend code references http:// resources.
All external actions (e.g., WhatsApp link) open secure URLs.
No browser mixed-content warnings occur in a standard HTTPS deployment.

requirements.text: Add the new professional images as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and wire them into the Hero/Services/About (team) areas where appropriate, using consistent styling and captions/alt text in English.

quotes: High-quality photos use karo (electric work, team photo). Icons se services ko visually highlight karo.

acceptanceCriteria: All newly generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced by components via /assets/generated/... paths.
The Services section uses the new service-specific photos for the 5 highlighted services.
A team photo is displayed in an appropriate place (e.g., About section) with descriptive English alt text.

constraints: Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Keep existing contact details unchanged (phone 9953854470, email madhavielectricalsolutions@gmail.com).
Backend is single-actor Motoko; do not add additional backend services.
nonGoals: Do not integrate third-party review providers (e.g., live Google Reviews API); testimonials can be static.
Do not implement a full multi-page router unless required to satisfy the services clarity requirement; prioritize the existing single-page scroll model.
Do not change Internet Identity/authentication behavior.
Do not build an admin dashboard for managing testimonials or services in this request.
